description: A multi-source dataset of urban life in the city of Milan and the Province of Trentino is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Gianni Barlacchi et al. The study of socio-technical systems has been revolutionized by the amount of digital records that are constantly being produced by human activities such as accessing Internet services, using mobile devices, and consuming energy and knowledge. In this paper, we describe the richest open multi-source dataset ever released on two geographical areas. Coverage: not stated; published in 2015. Formats: TXT, GeoJSON. The data are held in Harvard Dataverse and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 2117045. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Custom terms specific to this dataset, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
